story_overview: On the Hillside Pavilion balcony, Leo takes a call. Elsewhere, a worried Jin also talks on his phone before having several serious conversations on the same balcony with Stanley, Wei, and Leo. Later, a group including Jin, Alex, Walter, and Rosa share a celebratory toast, while Ren is seen working at an industrial pig farm.

video_prompts:
Leo: Man wearing a purple and black striped shirt and blue jeans.
Hillside Pavilion: Building exterior with a wooden balcony decorated with red Chinese lanterns, overlooking a green, hilly landscape.
A low-angle medium shot shows Leo standing on Hillside Pavilion. He answers his phone and begins to talk. The red lantern hangs on the balcony nearby. In the background is a green, hilly landscape under an overcast sky.
action_descriptions: A low-angle medium shot shows Leo standing on Hillside Pavilion. He answers his phone and begins to talk. The red lantern hangs on the balcony nearby. In the background is a green, hilly landscape under an overcast sky.

video_prompts:
Jin: Middle-aged Asian man wearing a collared shirt with pink and grey stripes and a small black crossbody bag slung over his shoulder.
Verdant Hill: An outdoor hill covered in green grass.
the black flip phone: Black plastic flip phone with a small external screen, and an internal screen above a physical keypad.

Medium close-up of Jin standing on the grassy hill of Verdant Hill, wearing the pink and grey striped shirt. With a worried expression, he talks into the black flip phone held to his ear. He then lowers the black flip phone and looks down intently at its screen.

the set dining table: Large, round wooden dining table with five complete place settings, each including white ceramic plates, silver cutlery, and clear wine glasses.

the aviator sunglasses: Aviator-style sunglasses with thin silver metal frames and dark lenses.

Jin speaks to Stanley with a serious expression, while Walter stands beside them, listening. Stanley wears the aviator sunglasses. The red lantern hangs on the building in the background and the green officer's cap rests on the balcony railing.

Medium close-up in Hillside Pavilion of Jin talking seriously. He faces Stanley, who stands with his back to the camera. The green officer's cap rests on the wooden balcony railing as the red lantern hangs in the background with several others.

On the wooden balcony, Jin speaks with a serious expression to Stanley, who nods slowly as he listens. Leo stands nearby, occasionally glancing between them as the red lantern sways gently in the background.

Wei: East Asian man wearing a Green Security/Police Uniform and glasses.
